prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single universally “best” personal injury lawyer for a car wreck in Houston — the right attorney depends on the facts of your crash, the severity of injuries, whether the case is likely to settle or require a trial, and how comfortable you are with the lawyer’s style and communication. That said, here’s how to find a very strong one and what to ask.

How to choose
- Look for specific car-crash experience (not just general PI). Ask how many car-wreck cases they’ve handled and results in similar cases.
- Trial experience and courtroom success (many cases settle, but you want someone who will try the case if needed).
- Board certification in personal injury/civil trial law (a sign of recognized expertise).
- Strong client reviews, peer ratings (Martindale‑Hubbell, Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers) and demonstrable verdicts/settlements.
- Team & resources (investigators, medical experts, accident reconstruction).
- Contingency-fee arrangement (so you don’t pay unless you recover) with clear terms.
- Good communication — accessible lawyer or staff and a clear point of contact.

Questions to ask at a free consult
- Have you handled cases like mine (type of injury, fault dispute, uninsured motorist, etc.)?
- What’s your track record (verdicts/settlements) for similar cases?
- Will you personally handle my case or a junior attorney/paralegal?
- What is your contingency fee and what expenses are advanced? Who pays if we don’t win?
- What is your estimate for value and timeline?
- How will you keep me updated and how quickly do you respond to calls/emails?
- Are there any potential liens (medical providers, insurers) I should expect?

Red flags
- Guarantees of a specific result or an unusually high-pressure pitch.
- No written fee agreement or unwillingness to put terms in writing.
- Poor communication in the initial consult or evasive answers about experience.

Where to search
- Texas State Bar Lawyer Referral Service / find a lawyer on TexasBar.com
- Local directories/reviews (Google, Yelp) and legal rating sites (Martindale‑Hubbell, Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers)
- Houston Trial Lawyers Association / Texas Trial Lawyers Association

If you want, I can:
- Recommend highly rated Houston personal injury attorneys if you give your ZIP code or part of town, and a brief description of the crash/injuries; or
- Provide a checklist/email template you can use to contact and compare 3–5 attorneys.

Which would you prefer?
